quest.title: Neko Is a Cat: Cat and Stone
quest.description: Neko, "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine," seems to have business with you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Your timing is impeccable. I need your aid once more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Go on, shoot.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I desire...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: That you place a tall, large stone shaped in my own image beside this shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where are we supposed to find something like that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She means a statue, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, I desire something similar to those fox stones on that island far, far away.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hibiki used to say that there were lots of them on that island, and even asked if I would like one made in my image.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I feel that if Hibiki wanted it, it must be good. As such, I ask you to have one such stone made.

choices.text: I don't have any skill in carving...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmmm, what are we gonna do...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, why don't we ask Taisuke? He likes cats a lot. He might even be willing to take up carving just to help Neko!

choices.text: Well, I guess we could go look for Taisuke...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true! He's so fond of cats. Maybe he can help us!

talks.objective: Ask Etsuko and Taisuke some questions

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Ah, hello there. What are you busy with today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Helping Neko make a statue.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Uh... What? A statue, here? Really?

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: I—I'll pick up carving immediately!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I doubt you'll make it in time...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Hmm, is this another one of Neko's requests?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: You know what, I don't think it'll be that hard to find craftsmen looking for work, what with the issues we've been having in Tatarasuna.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: The Guild's received quite a few commissions related to this, and I've heard that some people are still in Tatarasuna looking for work.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: I encountered just such an encampment while on a commission.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: So if you want, you can try your luck there.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Heh, don't pay it any mind. It wasn't that hard.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: And you know what? I'd like to see what might happen if that shrine really does thrive again...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Especially that "Hibiki" Neko keeps talking about. What sort of person could be so beloved by that cat?

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Alright, don't worry, I'm just talking to myself. Go look for that artisan.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: As for whether they know how to carve rock or not... Well, I guess that's up to luck, eh?

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Come on, Miss Etsuko, you just want to help Lady Neko as well, don't you? Haha, you're such a—

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Taisuke, is our survey plan ready yet?

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Uh, I—I'm almost done. Sorry...

choices.text: You don't seem like your usual self, Etsuko.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: What, not used to me giving you information first?

talks.objective: Go to Tatarasuna to look for an artisan

dialogues.text: *sigh* When will I be able to find some work...
Are you looking for me? What is this about?

choices.text: Do you know how to make stone carvings?

response.text: Eh? Well... Well then, that's great!
Wait, sorry, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Ooshima Junpei, and I used to work at Tatarasuna.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: After that accident, we were all evacuated.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: But till now, I haven't received any notice that we might be returning to work, so I've been idle here this whole time.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: So you're looking for someone who can do some stone carving, right? Well, that's not my specialty per se, but I do have some skill in it...

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: What sort of stone carving do you need made? Could you tell me?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, here's the situation...

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Uh... So, let me get this straight. A talking cat wants you to find a craftsman to make a carved statue of it?

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: It's not like I don't believe you or anything. It's just a bit... You know, outrageous...

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: And even if I agreed, how is that... that provisional head priestess supposed to pay me? I'm not going to work for free, no matter what anyone says.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Relax, it'll be fine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (...Will it really, though...)

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Will it? I... Hmm, it just feels like you're swindling me...

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Still... You know what? Never mind. I'm a pair of idle hands anyway. Might as well go with you to have a look.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: I really hope that I can get paid...

choices.text: We're looking for an artisan who can work with stone.

talks.objective: Report back to Neko together with Ooshima Junpei

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Still, I am curious. How will a thing as hard as stone take on my countenance?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Is that stone human very powerful? Can he use some magic?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Ah, I understand. Lovely!

choices.text: It's like that time with the meal we made...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Ah, I understand. The meals you and Hibiki made were all good things. The stone that the stone human will make must then also be a good thing.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Humans can be quite skilled sometimes, it seems. You have my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Ah, you have returned. This human must be the stone human, yes?

choices.text: This is the artisan we hired.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: ...What!? The cat... it really can talk!

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Meow meow meow, such ado about nothing... Is it so strange that I speak?

choices.text: No need to make a fuss.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Wait. Are you saying that this is something super normal for you!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That certainly has been the case so far.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: What in the world have you experienced...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Come now, we are not here to merely talk.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Back to our main point. Stone human, can you knock on stone and cause it to look like me?

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Eh? Stone human? You mean me?

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: "Knock on stone," you say... Well, I can give stone-working a go...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Is that so? Wonderful, meow meow meow.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: S—So this is how it is, huh... Well, having a job is better than nothing. I mean, I've never worked for a cat before, so... I guess we'll just discuss my salary later?

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Hmm. Either way, I'll need to make some preparations. There are quite a few rocks here on this island. I'll need to pick a good one.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Ah, yes. How should I address you?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I am the Neko, the provisional head priestess of the Asase Shrine.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: As to terms of address, you may call me whatever you please, tall, stone-knocking human.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Is that so? Well then, I suppose I shall call you Lady Priestess. You are my employer, after all.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: ...What is an "envoyer"?

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: W—Well, I'll go look around and pick a rock to use, then. You all just stay here for now.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Working for a cat. Well, that's a first...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mr. Ooshima seems to have forgotten all about that payment.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I will leave the matter of stone to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look! That's the camp that Miss Etsuko told us about. There's someone in there, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go ask around. Maybe he knows a thing or two about carving stone...
